<details>
The file contains a standard post_install script that sets a Linux file capability using setcap. The cap_dac_override capability grants the espanso binary the ability to override normal file permission checks, which is a legitimate requirement for a text expander to function across different user contexts and file locations. This capability adjustment supports the application's stated purpose and is analogous to other permission modifications (like nice/rtprio limits) considered normal in packaging. There are no network requests, obfuscated code, eval/base64 usage, data exfiltration, or any other genuinely malicious indicators. The post_upgrade function simply delegates to post_install, which is standard practice.
</details>
